limitations: Byte-exact extracted original source and pinned tiny records/events, not a game run, natural collection, replay, or runtime mode matrix.
Full original constructor, allocator, spawn function and lethal linked traversal execute; mt_rand is a deterministic counted stream, not the original RNG engine/state.
Large-explosion and renderer sinks only observe; effect state and draw arguments are compared, not actual renderer pixels.

Exact collection envelope/scoreitem branch, ordinary-shot ascending avail0 collision prefix/predicate and movement through background-y execute. The first-shot-match observer returns its first match; weapon movement, damage aftermath, piercing/special-shot behavior and enemy shooting branches are not simulated.

Earlier link82 actors are not assumed absent: exact caller link0-to255 normalization and lethal-sweep match/link-minus100/lower-equal20 eligibility are tested. First-collision tests cover lower-slot side actor at dx12 and lead31 at exact dy15 without asserting runtime actor presence.
LeakSanitizer is disabled for executor compatibility; AddressSanitizer and UBSan remain enabled.
